# iColorPacks

iColorPacks / Wenzhou iColor Packaging Co., Ltd. provides custom paper-based packaging for brand and wholesale projects. All product types start at 100 pieces per size and artwork. Small-batch orders have a higher unit price because setup costs are spread over fewer pieces. Sampling, production timing and delivery options are confirmed for the project.
